text:
Jess - Growth: Heads-up — we need a 1-pager / cheat-sheet that helps enterprise buyers pick between Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Security-first framing, quick SLA comparators, and one column for 'when to pick this' (use-cases).

Omar - PMM: Agreed. Make it usable by SDRs and that it must have a short benchmark callout (latency SLOs + cost ballpark). Also include a 1-line summary for each deployment mode.

Leah - Solutions: Can we add a small section: 'Compliance & network patterns' (e.g., VPCs, peering, on-prem air-gapped) + KMS/HSM notes. Customers always ask about key custody.

Samir - Sales: Needs an inbound routing snippet — mapping of lead intent to GTM path. Example: "legal/security-first" -> AE + security briefing; "pilot/POC" -> Solutions + Dedicated trial. If you can surface the HubSpot lifecycle stage + 3 suggested qualification questions, that'd help SDRs.

Marco - Product: For benchmark narrative let's be honest and narrow: show median 95th-percentile latency for common gen workloads (e.g., 1k tokens, 512 context) and cost per 1M tokens for each mode with a note: "your mileage varies". Avoid huge claims; include a short methodology line (internal benchmark harness, synthetic workload, configs).

Jess - Growth: Good. Draft layout idea below (for the one-pager content). Keep copy punchy and scannable.

```
Top: 1-sentence value prop (security, predictability, unified API)
Left column: Hosted — 3 bullets (fast onboarding, best for dev/test, usage-based pricing) + 1-line latency/cost callout
Middle: Dedicated — 3 bullets (reserved capacity, predictable throughput, SLA) + 1-line latency/cost callout
Right: Private — 3 bullets (VPC/on-prem, KMS/HSM, audit logs) + 1-line latency/cost callout
Below: Compliance matrix rows (SOC2, ISO27001, FedRAMP, Data residency) with simple check / partial / consult
Bottom-left: Inbound routing cheatsheet (intent -> owner/team -> next-step) with 3 qualification Qs
Bottom-right: Quick benchmark blurb + link to full benchmark deck
Footer: CTA (request a technical briefing | get a trial)
```

Leah - Solutions: For the compliance matrix use 'Yes / Limited / Contact PM' language — simpler than checkmarks. Also add a note about "fallback policies" (can route to hosted if Dedicated saturated).

Samir - Sales: I'll add the HubSpot tags: "enterprise:security", "enterprise:pilot", "enterprise:volume" and a play: tag -> create opportunity -> schedule intro call. Also give SDRs a short script:

Samir - Sales: "Thanks for reaching out — quick Q: are you evaluating for a regulated workload (yes/no)? If yes, we route you to Solutions for a secure private demo. If no, we can spin a Dedicated trial in X days."

Omar - PMM: For the benchmark snippet text: keep it like "95th-pctl latency: Hosted 120ms | Dedicated 80ms | Private 90-150ms (depends on infra). Typical cost per 1M tokens: Hosted $X | Dedicated (amortized) $Y | Private customer-dependent." Put a small asterisk leading to methodology.

Marco - Product: I'll supply the actual numbers and a short note on how quantization and batching affect the numbers. Leave a placeholder in the one-pager for us to fill before launch.

Jess - Growth: Next steps: Omar to draft the copy + headline by EOD Friday, Marco to drop benchmark numbers by Monday, Leah to provide compliance wording, Samir to confirm HubSpot tags and SDR script. I'll create a Notion page and a 1-slide PDF.

Marco - Product: FYI, benchmark deck link (internal): https://notion.redwood/benchmarks/enterprise-inference (will update with final table)

LaunchBot: Reminder — new collateral must go through legal review (legal@redwood) 48h before publish.

Leah - Solutions: Can we also make a 2nd one-pager variant aimed at platform teams (more on rollout, canary, A/B, fallback)? It can be a single-column "tech cheat" that lives next to the main one-pager.

Jess - Growth: Yes — do a compact "Platform cheat" version after we finalize enterprise one.

Samir - Sales: :thumbsup: will start routing tagged leads to AE queue once tags are finalized.

Omar - PMM: I'll put the first draft in Notion and ping the channel. Thanks all.

Jess - Growth: Thanks team — quick, scannable, security-first. Target to publish the one-pager as part of next week's outbound and webinar landing page.

(threads end)
